name: Neon Crucible
difficulty_label: Hard — guided missiles, repairing machines and four uploaded boss bodies
description: Bolt Ironcore’s lost bridgeworks float above an aether-lit abyss: worn fabrication presses, memory archives, circulating coolant and Continuum’s distant uplink. Follow the machinery into salvage bays and a small living repair garden. Discover maintenance pods, wake hidden turrets and break Continuum’s four increasingly dangerous bodies. Each upload sends the same intelligence to a distant backup chassis.
